system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the ReadersWriters specification. It instantiates the number of actor processes to a small finite value and configures the model checker to verify the safety and liveness properties of the fair readers-writers solution.
actors_and_components: This module extends the parent ReadersWriters specification and inherits all its actors and components: the set of actor processes, the reader and writer sets, and the waiting queue. It also extends a model-checking utilities module.
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from the parent ReadersWriters module: the set of active readers, the set of active writers, and the ordered queue of pending access requests.
initial_state: Inherited from the parent module: no readers, no writers, and an empty waiting queue.
actions: All actions are inherited from the parent ReadersWriters module: requesting to read, requesting to write, processing the front of the queue, and stopping activity.
safety_properties: The model checker verifies the type-correctness invariant and the safety invariant from the parent module: readers and writers are never simultaneously active, and at most one writer is active at any time.
liveness_properties: The model checker verifies the liveness property from the parent module: every process eventually reads and eventually writes, and every active process eventually stops.
model_bounds: The number of actors is set to 3 for model checking. This is small enough for exhaustive state-space exploration while still exercising concurrent interactions among multiple processes.
additional_assumptions: The module includes several commented-out invariants that are known to be violated, serving as examples of properties that do not hold for this specification. These can be used to generate counterexample traces.
